notes.title: New! Dust and Salt: The Battle for Murk is here!
notes.content:
Extremely proud to present to you the next adventure from the Sin Lands!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/835640/Dust_and_Salt_The_Battle_for_Murk/

To celebrate its launch it's 15% discounted. It adds another layer to the revenge story from the first and I am very curious to find out what you think of it.

notes.title: New Dust and Salt story coming in July!
notes.content:
The next story from the world of the Sin Lands is right around the corner! 

Add it to your wishlist here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/835640/Dust_and_Salt_The_Battle_for_Murk

In the first game you've battled numerous foes to build up an army and seek vengeance on the city of Murk. This time around you'll take the role of a corporal from the city watch of Murk itself! You'll experience the conflict from the enemy's point of view! Is the soul of the city as black as it seems? Is the path of vengeance at its end? All will be revealed in the final BATTLE FOR MURK!

notes.content:
[b]Fixed a bug[/b] with disappearing story text after clicking 'Center player' button followed by a click on a map location flag.

[i]Anyone who notices any unusual behavior let me know, please, and I'll fix it asap. Thank you all for your support![i]

notes.title: Updated to v.1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Major UPDATE![/b]

[i]I've tested as much as I could to make sure that the old version won't break but, please, let me know if you encounter any kind of new issues![/i]

[list]
[*][b]Added Steam Cloud integration![/b] 
Share your story state and progression between your computers.

[*][b]Added additional checkpoints.[/b]

[*][b]Reworked checkpoints system![/b] 
All checkpoints are now stored in the checkpoints vault which you can access from the chest icon at the top. Jump back and forth if you want to play all the possibilities without restarting the game.

[*][b]Added transition between story and map.[/b] 
Added functionality to Center Player button (flag icon at the top) that will bring you to the map while in story mode. Clicking back on the player figure will open up the story.

[*][b]Added new hints and tips.[/b]

[*][b]Added explanation when selecting your troops that the amount of squads in a unit don't result in damage increase but rather in "HP" increase.

[*][b]Fixed issue with tedious scrolling of text that was already seen when you resume game.[/b]

[*][b]Fixed issue with dyslexic font rendering with too much white space.[/b]
[/list]

[i]Thanks to everyone who has supported me with constructive feedback and ideas.[/i]

notes.title: [Fixed] Critical Bug Found, Working on a Fix ASAP
notes.content:
Update: The fix is live in version 1.1.0. Thank you all for your patience! I will continue to monitor this behavior just to make sure all is OK.

Hey, all! I want to warn you that a critical bug is found when your troops are diminished before entering battle but the hex battle doesn't result in defeat.

I am actively working on a fix, expect it by the end of today for both PC and Mac! I apologize for any inconvenience that this might cause! Until a fix is presented, you may use your checkpoints in case you stumble upon the issue and try to keep your troops alive till the end :)

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: This week s pick of new Steam releases
notes.content:
Winter has finally arrived in force in London, bringing with it some questions. Whose idea was it to live on the surface? Why would anyone wear a fleece without arms? What kind of monster thinks it’s okay to make a coat with fake pockets, and why didn’t everyone immediately kill him with spears?

Alas, these are not questions that Unknown Pleasures can answer. But if your local mountaintop hermit has no idea what the best new Steam releases are, you’re in luck.

Lining our inexplicably porous gloves this week: liminal AIs, invisible mines, and gender critical spies.

(more…)

notes.title: [Fixed] Critical Bug on Mac OS X
notes.content:
Update: Fix is live in update 1.0.9. Thank you all who helped sort out the issue!

Dear all,

A critical bug has been found and reproduced successfully by me on Mac OS X.  Anyone who hits an area where there is an achievement is affected by the bug. The game "freezes" and you cannot progress any further. Neither 'Load Checkpoint', nor 'New Game'/'Resume Game' will fix it.

I apologize for the inconvenience! Working on a fix and I hope to upload one by the end of today.
